payload.summary: 3-core builder-spender loop: cast blue builder skills (Heavy Crush, Power Shoulder, Dreadnaught, Endure Pain) to generate Gravity Cores. At 3 cores activate Gravity Release skills for empowered damage. Rage Hammer increases Gravity Release skill damage. Seismic Hammer animation-cancelled with spacebar for faster rotation. Primary damage (Gravity Release): Perfect Swing, Seismic Hammer, Full Swing, Earth Eater. Builders: Heavy Crush, Dreadnaught, Endure Pain, Power Shoulder. Consistent damage throughout — no locked Hypergravity phase unlike Gravity Training.
